title: CDAO OpenAI Public Sector Prototype Other Transaction Agreement
summary: The Department's daily contract notice records a fixed-amount prototype other transaction agreement, HQ0883-25-9-0012, valued at $200 million, with $1,999,998 in fiscal 2025 RDT&E funds obligated at award.
key_findings: OpenAI Public Sector is the named performer on a $200 million prototype agreement.
The stated scope is frontier AI prototypes for warfighting and enterprise national-security challenges.
The notice reports $1,999,998 obligated at award and an estimated July 2026 completion.
why_it_matters: The notice converts general federal AI acquisition policy into a named performer, instrument, ceiling, initial obligation, work domain, and completion gate.
ftfn_relevance: Provides an auditable AI infrastructure and procurement action rather than a broad strategy statement.
Creates follow-up questions for tasking, later obligations, prototypes, assurance, acceptance, users, and follow-on production.
evidence_limits: Agreement value is not the same as obligated or spent funds; the notice records only $1,999,998 obligated at award.
The notice does not identify delivered systems, model performance, infrastructure, acceptance, operational use, or production transition.
